tools.name: check_packages
tools.description: Use for questions like 'is my stack secure?' or 'do we have vulnerable packages?'. Checks a list of exact installed package versions against public security advisories. Read them from the project's lockfiles, including transitive packages. Up to 500 per call; call again for more. verdict is yes, no

tools.name: check_platform
tools.description: Lists known security incidents at hosting, deployment and AI platforms, with what to do and a link to the source. Use when the user asks about a platform or breach. Omit name to list all. The list is curated and not complete, so no result doesn't mean a platform is safe.

tools.name: check_runtime
tools.description: Checks a Node.js or PHP version against known security flaws in the runtime itself. Use with the exact version, for example from `node --version` or `php --version`. The list is curated, so no findings doesn't prove a version is safe.

tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Checks one exact package version against public security advisories.
